70124001.text: You meet Alyosha at Sretomorozsk and successfully repair the train.

70120101.text: After you successfully leave the Shadow Realm, the Eye of Graeae renovates the train at Rankova Zorya. Now, you can head to Snezhnograd.

70121001.text: Alright, looks like our destination settings have been applied. Let's give this thing a final once-over and then head out. Goggles, your time to shine!

70121005.text: Think of it as a kind of autopilot system.

70121006.text: Engine: Green. Wheels: Green. Frame: ...Minor damage, but no impact on function.

70121008.text: Neat! Paimon still can't get over the fact that you just found this tech lying around in a random cave.

70121009.text: Yeah, I definitely lucked out there...

70121010.text: I've lived in Snezhnaya my whole life, and I've never heard of an interactive, talking train autopilot.

70121011.text: Strictly speaking, I wasn't designed purely to drive trains, though I doubt you have any interest in navigating the practically unreadable operator's manual yourself.

70121012.text: All configurations are complete. Should you require any further assistance, please call for the Eye of Graeae.

70121015.text: Nope, Paimon's gonna find a warmer seat...

subQuests.subQuestName: Drive the train using the Eye of Graeae

70121201.text: #Ugh... Wh—What is this place? {NICKNAME}, are you okay?

70121203.text: Uhh... Paimon's still airborne... But it feels like swimming through thick, gloopy water... Ugh, it's horrible...

70121204.text: Just our luck... Of all the things that could have gone wrong...

70121205.text: Alyosha, you're Snezhnayan right? Any idea what the heck this place is?

70121206.text: It's called the "Shadow Realm." A place where no wind blows, no light shines, and no elemental energy flows... even time itself doesn't exist here. It's a world where everything seems to come to a standstill.

70121207.text: I've only seen it a few times before, and this is my first time inside. It's a dangerous place. Most people who get sucked into the Shadow Realm are never seen again...

70121208.text: And the few who do make it back... They're never quite the same.

70121209.text: Huh? Then... What the heck do we do now?

70121213.text: Hold it together. Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I heard a story once about the "World of Shadows"... If it's true, there's a way to escape. We just need to find the exit.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the opponents, who have become twisted by the Shadow Realm
Examine your surroundings within the Shadow Realm

70121401.text: Wait, what's that blue thing? Is that... Goggles?

70121402.text: Guess we'd better find a way over.

subQuests.subQuestName: Meet up with the Eye of Graeae
Meet up with the Eye of Graeae

70121502.text: Hello. I am glad to see the three of you safe and sound.

70121503.text: For now, at least. But things aren't looking too good.

70121504.text: Correct. We are now inside what is known as the Shadow Realm — the darkest space in the shell, where even the most high is loath to cast its gaze.

70121505.text: Time and space hold no meaning here. It intersects with the world of the Light Realm only rarely, like an air bubble that rises to the water's surface.

70121506.text: We must leave this place before it sinks back down into the depths once more.

70121507.text: Sounds like you have a plan.

70121508.text: ...Yes. In fact, the very purpose of my creation was likely to... ... ...from the Shadow Realm.

70121509.text: ...It appears that key data is currently inaccessible. But now is not the time to resolve that problem.

70121510.text: #I have marked the exit to the Shadow Realm for your convenience. In addition, I have prepared some equipment to aid you as you traverse the Shadow Realm, {NICKNAME}...

70121513.text: It may well be one of my core functions... Scan complete. Construction in progress...

70121514.text: Activation code: "We once peered into the past from the ruins of the shadows. This is what remains of the Golden City, Hyperborea."

subQuests.subQuestName: Destroy the explosive barrel to clear the obstacles

70122202.text: I suggest a new strategy: Take cover, and pick them off one by one.

70122301.text: Hmm, how do we get over there now?

70122302.text: I recommend using this Grappling Gun. Such devices were originally used to secure structures in the Shadow Realm.

70122303.text: If you detach the connected Hook, the Grappling Gun will automatically fire a rope to another nearby Hook...

70122304.text: Kay... So we just remove this hook, right?

70121701.text: Uhh... Why is everything shaking so much?

70121702.text: Looks like the Shadow Realm is about to "sink back down into the depths."

70121704.text: You mean this... this weird bubble thing? ...Wait, um, how exactly do we—

70121705.text: No time to think — we just gotta go for it...

70121706.text: Phew... Looks like I was right!
